name: Friday4:30
description:
What Friday4:30 Does

Friday4:30 gives food and drink businesses one place to run a product safety event, from the first weak signal to the closing report.

Working directly in your workspace
With this connector, Claude can:

• Declare an incident and seed its response tasks
• Log and triage consumer complaints
• Raise an awareness for a signal that isn't yet confirmed
• Pull your product and supplier registers to scope a recall
• Check the readiness score and what's dragging it down
• Read the daily morning briefing, including matched external recall alerts

Reaching the wider record
Beyond the named tools, a capability catalogue exposes the rest of the workspace (risk register, batches and shipments for traceability, Sedex audit findings, incident costs, drills, response meetings, comms templates, and the activity audit trail) so Claude can answer questions across the whole record.

Access and trust
Every call acts as the signed-in user and is bound by that user's role and organisation, so Claude sees exactly what the person sees and nothing more. Workspace text written by outside parties (consumer complaints, imported tickets, news feeds) is fenced as untrusted data rather than instructions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Friday4:30 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Friday4:30 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.friday430.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Friday4:30 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Friday4:30 lists 18 MCP tools, including add_incident_comment, api_create, api_read, api_update, create_awareness, create_incident, create_task, get_incident, get_morning_briefing, get_readiness_score, list_awarenesses, and list_capabilities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Friday4:30?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Friday4:30 in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Friday4:30 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Friday4:30 is developed by Friday 4:30. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
